neighbours.label: A short predicate that closes an emphatic verdict on something just mentioned ('Because it works!', 'and boy was it big'), peaking on the predicate; the same word in a plain descriptive clause stays lower.
fire: Why do I keep buying this brand? Because it lasts!
You saw that shark, and boy was it huge!
Why trust this method? Because it delivers!
I bought that couch, and boy is it soft!
People doubted the plan, but it worked!
Why stick with this old car? Because it runs!
quiet: This brand of battery lasts about a year.
A huge shark swam past the small boat.
The boring lecture ran past noon.
This method delivers water to the roots.
A soft couch stood by the window.
People worked on the plan through the night.
That tough exam was given in May.
This old car runs on diesel fuel.

notes: Probes: ' works' 0.36-0.65, ' big' 0.61, ' long' 0.37; ' helps' and ' hot' about 0.20, 'It works.' 0.06. So the median is at risk. The output direction promotes '.', ';', ','. Near misses read 0.01-0.15.
